geocode.display_name: The Bronx, Bronx County, New York, United States
geocode.notes: Verified live geocode. User-approx coords (~40.8448, -73.8648) and prior natal_profiles.json values are nearby; this file is the daily-feed source of truth.

houses.notes: Daily feed houses/angles use the daily transit snapshot datetime at this Bronx location. Natal houses use birth datetime at the same location. ASC/MC from Swiss ascmc; DSC=ASC+180, IC=MC+180.

arabic_parts.notes: Arabic Parts on the daily feed are computed from natal ASC + natal planets (not transit planets). Only formulas already defined in-repo are emitted.
